chunks: And Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Abū Jaʿfar Bimirdaʿah; he said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man married a woman upon her judgment, then died before she made the determination. He said: She has no dowry, and she inherits.

key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a woman; the wife in this legal case
key_terms.بِحُكْمِهَا: upon her judgment; with the determination left to her decision
key_terms.تَرِثُ: she inherits from the deceased husband
key_terms.صَدَاقٌ: dowry due to the wife in marriage

ai.seo_question: If a husband dies before the wife determines the dowry in a marriage left to her judgment, does she inherit and is she entitled to a dowry?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a marriage in which the amount or determination of the dowry was left to the woman’s judgment, but the husband died before that judgment was made. The ruling states that she does not receive a dowry in this case, while her right of inheritance from him remains established.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4450 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abu Ja'far with reference to Mird'ah:

I said to Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who married a woman based on her terms but then died before she made her decision (regarding the terms).
Imam (as) said: "She is not entitled to a dowry (sadaq), but she inherits from him."
